name: WIA Gold Limited
summary: WIA Gold Limited, a West Perth explorer incorporated in 2010, evaluates gold, copper and other base metal prospects in Namibia and Côte d'Ivoire. Most attention goes to Côte d'Ivoire, where four properties, Bouaflé, Mankono, Issia and Bocanda, jointly span 3,038 square kilometers. It was formerly Tanga Resources Limited.
